# Mintt Studio

> Shopify apps for shoppable Instagram feeds, TikTok storefront video, free gifts with purchase, and Shop discovery. Official marketing site at minttstudio.com.

Mintt Studio builds storefront widgets and commerce apps used by Shopify merchants worldwide. Product detail is distributed across product pages below; Shopify App Store installs use the canonical app URLs listed under Apps.

## Essential pages

- [Home](https://minttstudio.com/): Marketing homepage: Instagram feed widgets, social proof, and Shopify positioning.
- [Mintt Instafeed](https://minttstudio.com/instafeed-instagram-feed): Main Instagram / shoppable video feed product page.
- [Pricing](https://minttstudio.com/pricing): Instafeed pricing tiers for Shopify stores.
- [About](https://minttstudio.com/about): Company overview.
- [Contact](https://minttstudio.com/contact): Contact Mintt Studio.

## Apps (Shopify App Store)

- [Mintt Instafeed on Shopify](https://apps.shopify.com/instafeed?surface_detail=mintt-studio-website): Install Instafeed from the Shopify App Store.
- [Mintt Free Gift on Shopify](https://apps.shopify.com/mintt-free-gift?surface_detail=mintt-studio-website): Free gift with qualifying orders. App Store listing.

## Other products & features

- [Mintt TikTok Feed](https://minttstudio.com/mintt-tiktok-feed): TikTok content on Shopify storefronts.
- [Mintt Free Gift](https://minttstudio.com/mintt-free-gift): Product page for the Free Gift app.
- [Spot & Pick: Shop](https://minttstudio.com/instafeed-shop): Shop app discovery and Spot & Pick positioning.
- [Shoppable Videos](https://minttstudio.com/shoppable-videos): Video commerce features.
- [UGC](https://minttstudio.com/ugc): User-generated content on storefronts.
- [Fast & Secure](https://minttstudio.com/fast-secure): Performance and compliance messaging.
- [Integrations](https://minttstudio.com/integrations): Partner and integration ecosystem.
- [Developers](https://minttstudio.com/developers): Mintt API for custom integrations; Shopify today, broader platform support coming soon. API docs: https://docs.minttstudio.com/developer-api/docs/instafeed-api/developer-api

## Customers & proof

- [Our customers](https://minttstudio.com/shopify-instafeed-demo): Customer examples and demos.
- [Case studies](https://minttstudio.com/case-studies): Merchant case studies.

## Content & help

- [Blog](https://minttstudio.com/blog): Articles and guides for Shopify merchants.
- [Help Center](https://docs.minttstudio.com/): Documentation and support (external).
- [Virtual demo (YouTube)](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=t1wmSbFuQMU): Recorded walkthrough.
- [Video tutorials (playlist)](https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLqPxxX7ZBGxc4_CLv2mwUmWD5Owb0ETvQ): Official YouTube playlist.

## Policies

- [Privacy Policy](https://minttstudio.com/privacy-policy)
- [Terms of Service](https://minttstudio.com/terms-of-service)

## Discovery

- [Sitemap](https://minttstudio.com/sitemap.xml): Machine-readable URL list for crawlers.

## Contact & social

- General inquiries and partnership: use [Contact](https://minttstudio.com/contact).
- [LinkedIn: Mintt Studio](https://www.linkedin.com/company/minttstudio)
- [YouTube channel](https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCU5Io0I2CSqIEMAtj5gNjrA)

Questions

How do I add an Instagram feed to my Shopify store?

You can add an Instagram feed to your Shopify store by using an Instagram feed widget like Mintt Instafeed. Simply install the app from the Shopify App Store, connect your Instagram account, and configure your layout. The widget will automatically sync and display your posts on your website.

What is Mintt Instafeed and how does it work?

Mintt Instafeed is a powerful yet easy-to-use Shopify app that displays shoppable Instagram feeds on your storefront. It helps merchants increase engagement, build social proof with UGC (user-generated content), and drive conversions - all without slowing down your store.

How much does Mintt Instafeed cost?

Mintt Instafeed offers a free Instagram widget plan with no branding, ideal for all Shopify stores looking for a free Instagram plugin for website. The free plan includes core features like automatic syncing, responsive design, and customizable layouts. For merchants who want to unlock advanced features - such as product tagging, UGC from tagged posts, hashtag filtering, and file uploads - Mintt Instafeed offers flexible paid plans. Every paid plan comes with a 7-day free trial.

Will Mintt Instafeed slow down my Shopify store?

Not at all - Mintt Studio is fully optimized for performance. It's lightweight and has zero impact on your store's speed.

How do Instagram feeds improve social proof on my website?

Displaying an Instafeed or UGC on your storefront helps build social proof for eCommerce, by showing customers using your products in a real-life context. Mintt Instafeed supports Instagram tagged posts, hashtag filtering, product tagging/ shoppable feeds, and more, giving you full control over the content displayed and experience.

Can I see examples of Instagram feeds on Shopify stores?

You can see real examples of Shopify stores using embedded Instagram feeds by checking out stores that use the Mintt Instafeed widget here.

Does Mintt Instafeed offer Enterprise-grade security?

Yes. The Mintt Instafeed app is Built for Shopify, meeting Shopify's highest standards for security, performance, and reliability. It's also an official Meta-approved app and aligns with GDPR and industry best practices to protect your data. Please check our Privacy Policy at /privacy-policy for detailed information. Mintt is optimized for performance, won't slow down your store, and is suitable for high-traffic and Shopify Plus stores.
